intro: Malaysia is a federal constitutional monarchy with a unique system: its king is chosen in turn from the rulers of nine states.

chapters.title: A rotating king
text: Nine states have hereditary rulers, mostly sultans. Every five years they choose one of themselves to be king, the Yang di-Pertuan Agong. The prime minister leads the government and needs a majority in parliament.
There are 13 states and 3 federal territories, and Sabah and Sarawak have extra powers.

chapters.title: Politics
text: One coalition ruled from 1957 until 2018. Since then several coalitions have taken turns, and Anwar Ibrahim became prime minister in 2022.

keyTerms.meaning: A union of states with a central government.
